app.changelog:
StrykerOSS 1.0.5 — custom Xiaomi/MIUI USB kernel + WiFi firmware.

- Custom arm64 kernel (6.12.94) with a two-layer Xiaomi/MIUI USB fix: a QEMU host-libusb quirk plus a hub.c else-if that reclassifies full-speed devices misreported as low-speed, so Realtek dongles no longer fail with “Invalid ep0 maxpacket” on Xiaomi phones (Poco F1 etc.).
- Kernel now ships USB-WiFi drivers (rtl8xxxu / rtw88 / ath9k_htc / carl9170 / mt76 / rt2x00 / rtl8187 / zd1211rw) enabled, with rtl8188fufw.bin + rtl8188eufw.bin + rtw88 blobs baked into the rootfs — download the engine and WiFi just works.
- /lib/modules is populated and kernel modules (loop/squashfs/overlay) are built-in, so .img/.iso mounting and module recovery work without extra steps.
- Incremental repair: re-running the installer only fetches the missing core files instead of re-downloading everything.
- The guest agent is re-waited after the resize2fs cycle so tools come back instead of showing “VM not reachable on :1050”.

news.title: Stryker 6.0 — Rootless engine & Debian
news.description: The full toolset now runs without root: Stryker boots an arm64 QEMU virtual machine and routes tools into the guest. The chroot moved from Alpine to Debian trixie, the same rootfs the VM boots. Also new: a root-free network scanner (mDNS, SSDP, NetBIOS, SNMP), Cameradar RTSP discovery, a reworked dashboard and VM settings. RouterScan has been removed. arm64-v8a only.
